text: sed -n '76,98p' src/ir_lower/expr/lazy_branches.rs: ue.kind { // The RECEIVER is part of the chain `??` probes, so a name that was never assigned // raises nothing there: `$x->p ?? "d"` answers `"d"` in silence. let object = lower_null_probe_chain(ctx, object); if property_can_be_uninitialized(ctx, object.value, property) { return lower_initialized_property_value(ctx, object, property, value); } return lower_property_get_from_value(ctx, object, property, Op::PropGet, value); } // A typed STATIC property starts uninitialized the same way, and its guard lives in the // backend rather than in an operation the lowering could branch on — so `??` needs its own // probe here too. `S::$s ?? "d"` raised where PHP answers `d`. if let ExprKind::StaticPropertyAccess { receiver, property } = &value.kind { if static_property_can_be_uninitialized(ctx, receiver, property) { return lower_initialized_static_property_value(ctx, receiver, property, value); }
